A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with 35 complete pages including Appendices A–J. Text and rendering comparisons establish identical scientific content; pages 2–35 are pixel-identical, and page 1 differs only in its arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: Section 5 and Appendix H report original experiments on action clustering, disentanglement, prediction, generalization and robustness, with numerical results and qualitative demonstrations.

after.justification: Section 5 and Appendix H retain the same original empirical results, including benchmark comparisons, action-clustering outcomes and latent-manipulation demonstrations.

M1.justification: The A-VAE, action-clustering and GMA-VAE pipeline is identical, including action-matrix parameterization, masking, entropy annealing and the continuous-action adaptation (Sections 4 and 5.6).

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Flatland variants, COIL environments including larger action-clustering scenarios, 3DShapes and MPI3D. Prediction, generalization, noisy-action and latent-manipulation scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in every corresponding experiment: LSBD-VAE, LSBD-VAE*, SOBDRL, HAE, the unsupervised VAE baselines and random encoders retain their respective participation. Forward-VAE remains excluded from the reported baselines.

E3.justification: Both specify the same metrics, latent dimensions, transition sampling, iid/ood restrictions and action-noise settings. Appendix I also retains the same five-step trajectories and training settings.

E4.justification: The analyses of limited transition coverage, long-term prediction, distribution shift and action noise are unchanged. Appendix H retains identical model-selection, action-entanglement, latent-manipulation and clustering-distance analyses.

E5.justification: Appendix H.4 reports means over five seeds with 68% confidence intervals in both versions. Figures 6–7 retain median results with 25th–75th-percentile displays; no run-count or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match, including 100% clustering recovery in Section 5.2 and GMA-VAE's COIL2 mean prediction error of 7.4e-5 in Table 6. No result entries, plotted findings or qualitative examples were added or removed.

T1.justification: The definitions, Assumptions 1–3, Theorems 1–3 and 3', and mathematical material in Appendices A–G are identical, including the ELBO derivation, proofs and block-diagonal counterexamples.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain identical claims about group-decomposition identifiability, autonomous discovery, LSBD learning without subgroup-structure priors, and empirical advantages.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and applicability boundaries are unchanged. Both retain the limitations concerning disentangled actions, observability, continuous-group clustering, training two networks separately and insufficiently realistic experiments.

D1.justification: The reproducibility statement, code-access information and Appendix I implementation details are identical. These include dataset construction, Table 16 architectures, Adam, batch size 16, latent noise of 0.1 and clustering parameters.

R1.justification: The bibliography and research positioning are unchanged, including Section 3's LSBD comparisons and Section 6's discussion of causal, object-centric and equivariant representation learning.

P1.justification: Only administrative text changes: the arXiv stamp advances from v1 dated 12 March 2026 to v3 dated 25 May 2026, and PDF author metadata switches name order. Visible authors, scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, equations, captions and their placement are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. Rendered pages 2–35 are identical, and page 1's body and layout are identical apart from the version/date text.

improvement.justification: The scientific text, proofs, experiments, interpretations, limitations and reproducibility information are identical across both PDFs, including all appendices. Updating the arXiv stamp and author metadata produces no meaningful change in clarity, evidential strength or overall paper quality.
